'''Whitestone City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]] in [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. The city was named after a kind of hard, white stone [[Mining/Legends|mined]] from the mounds on the planet. When [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the city late in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> she compared the governmental palace to a falling-star dome, which was a type of toy sold in many souvenir shops around the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Choices" />
